verdict.rationale: The pricing page says Unstructured can be deployed in your own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation, and the docs include a dedicated-instance security model (IP allowlisting). This is a sales-gated enterprise offering with tailored pricing, and the evidence describes no install path, open-source core, or self-managed tooling an individual user could run. missing for 10: documented self-install/deployment instructions (e.g. container images or a local open-source library), availability outside an enterprise contract, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.
